WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telesc_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(telesc_count) as total FROM telescope_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telesc_count,
    CAST(tc.telesc_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares
),
above_avg_obs AS (
  SELECT 
    s.observstation,
    s.telesc_count,
    s.share
  FROM shares s
  WHERE s.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)
)
SELECT
  AVG(aa.telesc_count) as avg_telescope_count,
  AVG(aa.share) as avg_share,
  AVG(aa.share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share) as avg_excess_share
FROM above_avg_obs aa;
